name: the-plot-tickens

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.data:legacy: tsx pipeline/import-litclock-csv.ts .corpus/legacy/literature-clock/litclock_annotated.csv .corpus/litclock-johsenevoldsen.jsonl litclock-johsenevoldsen 'CC BY-NC-SA 2.5' https://github.com/JohsEnevoldsen/literature-clock && tsx pipeline/import-litclock-csv.ts .corpus/legacy/litclock/image-gen/litclock_annotated.csv .corpus/litclock-kapoorankush.jsonl litclock-kapoorankush 'CC BY-NC-SA 4.0' https://github.com/kapoorankush/litclock && tsx pipeline/import-litclock-csv.ts .corpus/legacy/literary-clock/data/quotes.csv .corpus/litclock-itsfoss.jsonl litclock-itsfoss 'CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (inherited)' https://github.com/itsfoss/literary-clock
